tip: देखा जा सकता है (dekha ja sakta hai) = 'it can be seen' – literally 'seen go can'. Hindi builds 'can be X-ed' with जाना (jana = go) after the main verb.
करवाए गए (karvaye gaye) = 'were gotten done' – the -वा- (va) inside the verb means someone else did it. करना (karna) = do, करवाना (karvana) = have someone do.
Requests come FROM people in Hindi: कर्मचारियों से अनुरोध है (karmchariyon se anurodh hai) = 'from the employees is a request' – से (se = from), not 'to'.
'Because of' follows its noun: त्योहार के कारण (tyohar ke kaaran) = 'festival because-of'. के कारण (ke kaaran) always comes after the reason, never before.
English needs 'It is expected that' – Hindi just says उम्मीद है कि (ummeed hai ki = hope is that). No dummy 'it': the noun उम्मीद (ummeed = hope) leads.
बैठकर (baithkar) = 'having sat' – where English says 'sitting on the swing', Hindi adds -कर (kar) to the first action: sit-then-want, all in one word.
चोर की दाढ़ी में तिनका (chor ki daadhi mein tinka) = 'a straw in the thief's beard' – guilt betrays itself. The nervous thief checks his own beard first.
